name: ModAB.Within
source: def Within (x y e : ℝ) : Prop := |x - y| ≤ e

name: ModAB.within_refl
source: lemma within_refl (x : ℝ) : Within x x 0 := by simp [Within]

name: ModAB.within_trans
source:
lemma within_trans {x y z e d : ℝ} (h : Within x y e) (g : Within y z d) :
    Within x z (e + d) := by
  rcases abs_le.mp h with ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp g with ⟨g₁, g₂⟩
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor <;> linarith

name: ModAB.within_add
source:
lemma within_add {x x' y y' e d : ℝ} (h : Within x' x e) (g : Within y' y d) :
    Within (x' + y') (x + y) (e + d) := by
  rcases abs_le.mp h with ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp g with ⟨g₁, g₂⟩
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor <;> linarith

name: ModAB.within_sub
source:
lemma within_sub {x x' y y' e d : ℝ} (h : Within x' x e) (g : Within y' y d) :
    Within (x' - y') (x - y) (e + d) := by
  rcases abs_le.mp h with ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp g with ⟨g₁, g₂⟩
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor <;> linarith

name: ModAB.within_abs
source:
lemma within_abs {x y e : ℝ} (h : Within x y e) : Within |x| |y| e := by
  exact le_trans (abs_abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub x y) h

name: ModAB.within_half
source:
lemma within_half {x y e : ℝ} (h : Within x y e) : Within (x/2) (y/2) (e/2) := by
  rcases abs_le.mp h with ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor <;> linarith

name: ModAB.within_mono
source:
lemma within_mono {x y e d : ℝ} (h : Within x y e) (g : e ≤ d) : Within x y d :=
  le_trans h g

name: ModAB.product_error
source:
lemma product_error {x x' y y' A B C D : ℝ}
    (hx : |x'| ≤ A) (hy : Within y' y B)
    (hd : Within x' x C) (hb : |y| ≤ D) :
    Within (x'*y') (x*y) (A*B+C*D) := by
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hx
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hd
  calc
    |x'*y' - x*y| = |x'*(y'-y)+(x'-x)*y| := by congr 1; ring
    _ ≤ |x'*(y'-y)| + |(x'-x)*y| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ = |x'| *|y'-y| + |x'-x| *|y| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    _ ≤ A*B+C*D := add_le_add
      (mul_le_mul hx hy (abs_nonneg _) hA)
      (mul_le_mul hd hb (abs_nonneg _) hC)

name: ModAB.square_error
source:
lemma square_error {x y e : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hy : y ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (h : Within x y e) :
    Within (x^2) (y^2) (2*e) := by
  have p := product_error (x := y) (x' := x) (y := y) (y' := x)
    (A := 1) (B := e) (C := e) (D := 1)
    (by rw [abs_of_nonneg hx.1]; exact hx.2) h h
    (by rw [abs_of_nonneg hy.1]; exact hy.2)
  simpa [pow_two, mul_two, two_mul] using p

name: ModAB.kappa_identity
source:
lemma kappa_identity {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    kappa r = (1 - (1-r)/(2*(1+r)))^2 := by
  unfold kappa
  congr 1
  field_simp
  ; ring

name: ModAB.kappa_hasDerivAt
source:
lemma kappa_hasDerivAt (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    HasDerivAt kappa ((1+3*r)/(1+r)^3) r := by
  have hd : 2*(1+r) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have h := (((hasDerivAt_const r (1:ℝ)).add
    ((hasDerivAt_id r).const_mul 3)).div
    (((hasDerivAt_const r (1:ℝ)).add (hasDerivAt_id r)).const_mul 2) hd).pow 2
  convert h using 1 <;> (try funext x) <;> (try dsimp [kappa]) <;> field_simp <;> ring

name: ModAB.kappa_derivative_bounds
source:
lemma kappa_derivative_bounds {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    0 < (1+3*r)/(1+r)^3 ∧ (1+3*r)/(1+r)^3 ≤ 1 := by
  have hp : 0 < (1+r)^3 := by positivity
  constructor
  · positivity
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hp).mpr
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg r) (by linarith : 0 ≤ 3+r)]

name: ModAB.kappa_lipschitz_ordered
source:
lemma kappa_lipschitz_ordered {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hxy : x < y) :
    |kappa y-kappa x| ≤ y-x := by
  have hc : ContinuousOn kappa (Set.Icc x y) := fun r hr =>
    (kappa_hasDerivAt r (hx.trans hr.1)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  obtain ⟨c,hc',hslope⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope kappa
    (fun r => (1+3*r)/(1+r)^3) hxy hc
    (fun r hr => kappa_hasDerivAt r (by linarith [hr.1]))
  have hd := kappa_derivative_bounds (show 0≤c by linarith [hc'.1])
  have habs : |(1+3*c)/(1+c)^3| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_of_pos hd.1]; exact hd.2
  rw [hslope,abs_div,abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hxy)] at habs
  simpa using (div_le_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hxy)).mp habs

name: ModAB.kappa_lipschitz
source:
lemma kappa_lipschitz {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    |kappa x-kappa y| ≤ |x-y| := by
  rcases lt_trichotomy x y with h|h|h
  · simpa only [abs_sub_comm (kappa x),abs_sub_comm x,
      abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr h)] using kappa_lipschitz_ordered hx h
  · subst y; simp
  · simpa only [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr h)] using kappa_lipschitz_ordered hy h

name: ModAB.kappa_lipschitz_algebraic
source:
lemma kappa_lipschitz_algebraic {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0≤x) (hy : 0≤y) :
    |kappa x-kappa y|≤|x-y| := by
  let d:=(1+x)^2*(1+y)^2
  let c:=(1+2*x+2*y+3*x*y)/d
  have hd : 0<d:=by dsimp [d]; positivity
  have hc0 : 0≤c:=by dsimp [c]; positivity
  have hc1 : c≤1:=by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr
    dsimp [d]
    have hp : 0≤x*y+x^2+y^2+2*x^2*y+2*x*y^2+x^2*y^2:=by positivity
    nlinarith only [hp]
  have hid : kappa x-kappa y=(x-y)*c:=by
    dsimp [kappa,c,d]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hid,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg hc0]
  nlinarith [abs_nonneg (x-y)]

name: ModAB.ratio_range
source:
lemma ratio_range {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    (1-r)/(2*(1+r)) ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (1/2) := by
  have hd : 0 < 2*(1+r) := by linarith [hr.1]
  constructor
  · apply div_nonneg <;> linarith [hr.1, hr.2]
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr
    linarith [hr.1]

name: ModAB.quotient_error
source:
lemma quotient_error {a A b B e : ℝ} (he : 0 ≤ e)
    (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hae : Within A a e) (hbe : Within B b e) :
    Within ((A/2)/B) (a/(2*b)) e := by
  change |A-a| ≤ e at hae
  have bp : 0 < b := by linarith
  have Bp : 0 < B := by linarith
  have h₁ : Within (A/(2*B)) (a/(2*B)) (e/2) := by
    unfold Within
    rw [← sub_div, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2*B)]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2*B)).mpr
    have hp := mul_nonneg he (sub_nonneg.mpr hB)
    nlinarith [hae]
  have h₂ : Within (a/(2*B)) (a/(2*b)) (e/2) := by
    have hid : a/(2*B)-a/(2*b) = a*(b-B)/(2*B*b) := by field_simp
    unfold Within
    rw [hid, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha.1,
      abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2*B*b)]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2*B*b)).mpr
    have hab : |b-B| ≤ e := by simpa [Within, abs_sub_comm] using hbe
    have hm : a*|b-B| ≤ e := by
      calc
        a*|b-B| ≤ 1*e := mul_le_mul ha.2 hab (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        _ = e := one_mul e
    have hprod : 1 ≤ B*b := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hB) (sub_nonneg.mpr hb)]
    have hep := mul_nonneg he (sub_nonneg.mpr hprod)
    nlinarith
  have h := within_trans h₁ h₂
  convert h using 1 <;> ring

name: ModAB.FactorTrace
source:
structure FactorTrace (e rho : ℝ) where
  (rhoHat aHat bHat vHat rHat kHat : ℝ)
  rho_range : rhoHat ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1
  a_range : aHat ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1
  b_range : bHat ∈ Set.Icc (1:ℝ) 2
  v_range : vHat ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (1/2)
  r_range : rHat ∈ Set.Icc (1/2:ℝ) 1
  k_range : kHat ∈ Set.Icc (1/4:ℝ) 1
  rho_error : Within rhoHat rho e
  a_error : Within aHat (1-rhoHat) e
  b_error : Within bHat (1+rhoHat) e
  v_error : Within vHat ((aHat/2)/bHat) e
  r_error : Within rHat (1-vHat) e
  k_error : Within kHat (rHat^2) e

name: ModAB.factor_error_from_coefficient
source:
theorem factor_error_from_coefficient {e rho : ℝ} (he : 0≤e)
    (t : FactorTrace e rho) (hp : Within (kappa t.rhoHat) (kappa rho) e) :
    Within t.kHat (kappa rho) (8*e) := by
  let v₀ := (1-t.rhoHat)/(2*(1+t.rhoHat))
  have hv₀ := ratio_range t.rho_range
  have hq := quotient_error he
    (a := 1-t.rhoHat) (A := t.aHat) (b := 1+t.rhoHat) (B := t.bHat)
    (by constructor <;> linarith [t.rho_range.1, t.rho_range.2])
    (by linarith [t.rho_range.1]) t.b_range.1 t.a_error t.b_error
  have hv : Within t.vHat v₀ (2*e) := by
    simpa [v₀, two_mul] using within_trans t.v_error hq
  have hr : Within t.rHat (1-v₀) (3*e) := by
    have hs := within_sub (within_refl (1:ℝ)) hv
    have ht := within_trans t.r_error hs
    convert ht using 1 ; ring
  have hs := square_error
    (x := t.rHat) (y := 1-v₀)
    (by constructor <;> linarith [t.r_range.1, t.r_range.2])
    (by constructor <;> dsimp [v₀] <;> linarith [hv₀.1, hv₀.2]) hr
  have hk : Within t.kHat (kappa t.rhoHat) (7*e) := by
    rw [kappa_identity t.rho_range.1]
    have ht := within_trans t.k_error hs
    convert ht using 1 ; ring
  have ht := within_trans hk hp
  convert ht using 1 ; ring

name: ModAB.factor_error
source:
theorem factor_error {e rho : ℝ} (he : 0≤e)
    (hrho : rho∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (t : FactorTrace e rho) :
    Within t.kHat (kappa rho) (8*e) := by
  have hp : Within (kappa t.rhoHat) (kappa rho) e:=
    le_trans (kappa_lipschitz t.rho_range.1 hrho.1) t.rho_error
  exact factor_error_from_coefficient he t hp

name: ModAB.factor_error_algebraic
source:
theorem factor_error_algebraic {e rho : ℝ} (he : 0≤e)
    (hrho : rho∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (t : FactorTrace e rho) :
    Within t.kHat (kappa rho) (8*e) := by
  have hp : Within (kappa t.rhoHat) (kappa rho) e:=
    le_trans (kappa_lipschitz_algebraic t.rho_range.1 hrho.1) t.rho_error
  exact factor_error_from_coefficient he t hp

name: ModAB.ScaledTrace
source:
structure ScaledTrace (e rho p1 p2 p3 : ℝ) where
  factor : FactorTrace e rho
  (p1Hat p2Hat p3Hat sumHat hHat diffHat productH productP rightHat gapHat : ℝ)
  p1_range : |p1Hat| ≤ 1
  p2_range : |p2Hat| ≤ 1
  p3_range : |p3Hat| ≤ 1
  sum_range : |sumHat| ≤ 1
  h_range : |hHat| ≤ 1/2
  p1_error : Within p1Hat p1 e
  p2_error : Within p2Hat p2 e
  p3_error : Within p3Hat p3 e
  sum_error : Within sumHat (p1Hat+p2Hat) e
  h_error : Within hHat (sumHat/2) e
  diff_error : Within diffHat (p3Hat-hHat) e
  productH_error : Within productH (factor.kHat*|hHat|) e
  productP_error : Within productP (factor.kHat*|p3Hat|) e
  right_error : Within rightHat (productH+productP) e
  gap_error : Within gapHat (rightHat-|diffHat|) e

name: ModAB.exactH
source: def exactH (p1 p2 : ℝ) : ℝ := (p1+p2)/2

name: ModAB.exactL
source: def exactL (p1 p2 p3 : ℝ) : ℝ := |p3-exactH p1 p2|

name: ModAB.exactR
source: def exactR (rho p1 p2 p3 : ℝ) : ℝ := kappa rho*(|exactH p1 p2|+|p3|)

name: ModAB.exactG
source: def exactG (rho p1 p2 p3 : ℝ) : ℝ := exactR rho p1 p2 p3 - exactL p1 p2 p3

name: ModAB.scaled_errors_from_factor
source:
theorem scaled_errors_from_factor {e rho p1 p2 p3 : ℝ} (he : 0 ≤ e)
    (hh : |exactH p1 p2| ≤ 1/2) (hp3 : |p3| ≤ 1)
    (t : ScaledTrace e rho p1 p2 p3) (hk : Within t.factor.kHat (kappa rho) (8*e)) :
    Within t.factor.kHat (kappa rho) (8*e) ∧
    Within t.hHat (exactH p1 p2) (3*e) ∧
    Within |t.diffHat| (exactL p1 p2 p3) (5*e) ∧
    Within t.rightHat (exactR rho p1 p2 p3) (19*e) ∧
    Within t.gapHat (exactG rho p1 p2 p3) (25*e) := by
  have hsum := within_trans t.sum_error (within_add t.p1_error t.p2_error)
  have hmid := within_trans t.h_error (within_half hsum)
  have hm : Within t.hHat (exactH p1 p2) (3*e) := by
    exact within_mono hmid (by linarith)
  have hl₀ := within_trans t.diff_error (within_sub t.p3_error hm)
  have hl : Within |t.diffHat| (exactL p1 p2 p3) (5*e) := by
    have ha := within_abs hl₀
    convert ha using 1 <;> (try dsimp [exactL]) <;> ring
  have hkb : |t.factor.kHat| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [t.factor.k_range.1] : 0 ≤ t.factor.kHat)]
    exact t.factor.k_range.2
  have pp₀ := product_error hkb (within_abs t.p3_error) hk (by simpa using hp3)
  have pp : Within t.productP (kappa rho*|p3|) (10*e) := by
    have ha := within_trans t.productP_error pp₀
    convert ha using 1 ; ring
  have ph₀ := product_error hkb (within_abs hm) hk (by simpa using hh)
  have ph : Within t.productH (kappa rho*|exactH p1 p2|) (8*e) := by
    have ha := within_trans t.productH_error ph₀
    convert ha using 1 ; ring
  have hright : Within t.rightHat (exactR rho p1 p2 p3) (19*e) := by
    have ha := within_trans t.right_error (within_add ph pp)
    convert ha using 1 <;> (try dsimp [exactR]) <;> ring
  have hgap : Within t.gapHat (exactG rho p1 p2 p3) (25*e) := by
    have ha := within_trans t.gap_error (within_sub hright hl)
    convert ha using 1 <;> (try dsimp [exactG]) <;> ring
  exact ⟨hk, hm, hl, hright, hgap⟩

name: ModAB.scaled_errors
source:
theorem scaled_errors {e rho p1 p2 p3 : ℝ} (he : 0≤e)
    (hrho : rho∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (hh : |exactH p1 p2|≤1/2) (hp3 : |p3|≤1)
    (t : ScaledTrace e rho p1 p2 p3) :
    Within t.factor.kHat (kappa rho) (8*e) ∧
    Within t.hHat (exactH p1 p2) (3*e) ∧
    Within |t.diffHat| (exactL p1 p2 p3) (5*e) ∧
    Within t.rightHat (exactR rho p1 p2 p3) (19*e) ∧
    Within t.gapHat (exactG rho p1 p2 p3) (25*e) :=
  scaled_errors_from_factor he hh hp3 t (factor_error he hrho t.factor)

name: ModAB.scaled_errors_algebraic
source:
theorem scaled_errors_algebraic {e rho p1 p2 p3 : ℝ} (he : 0≤e)
    (hrho : rho∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (hh : |exactH p1 p2|≤1/2) (hp3 : |p3|≤1)
    (t : ScaledTrace e rho p1 p2 p3) :
    Within t.factor.kHat (kappa rho) (8*e) ∧
    Within t.hHat (exactH p1 p2) (3*e) ∧
    Within |t.diffHat| (exactL p1 p2 p3) (5*e) ∧
    Within t.rightHat (exactR rho p1 p2 p3) (19*e) ∧
    Within t.gapHat (exactG rho p1 p2 p3) (25*e) :=
  scaled_errors_from_factor he hh hp3 t (factor_error_algebraic he hrho t.factor)

name: ModAB.guard_positive
source:
theorem guard_positive {e G g : ℝ} (he : 0 < e)
    (herr : Within g G (25*e)) (hguard : 32*e < g) : 0 < G := by
  have h := (abs_le.mp herr).2
  linarith

name: ModAB.guard_negative
source:
theorem guard_negative {e G g : ℝ} (he : 0 < e)
    (herr : Within g G (25*e)) (hguard : g < -(32*e)) : G < 0 := by
  have h := (abs_le.mp herr).1
  linarith

name: ModAB.complete_positive
source:
theorem complete_positive {e G g : ℝ}
    (herr : Within g G (25*e)) (hmargin : 57*e < G) : 32*e < g := by
  have h := (abs_le.mp herr).1
  linarith

name: ModAB.complete_negative
source:
theorem complete_negative {e G g : ℝ}
    (herr : Within g G (25*e)) (hmargin : G < -(57*e)) : g < -(32*e) := by
  have h := (abs_le.mp herr).2
  linarith

name: ModAB.certified_switch
source:
theorem certified_switch {e rho p1 p2 p3 : ℝ} (he : 0 < e)
    (hrho : rho ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hh : |exactH p1 p2| ≤ 1/2) (hp3 : |p3| ≤ 1)
    (t : ScaledTrace e rho p1 p2 p3) (hguard : 32*e < t.gapHat) :
    exactL p1 p2 p3 < exactR rho p1 p2 p3 := by
  have herr := (scaled_errors (le_of_lt he) hrho hh hp3 t).2.2.2.2
  have h := guard_positive he herr hguard
  dsimp [exactG] at h
  linarith

name: ModAB.certified_no_switch
source:
theorem certified_no_switch {e rho p1 p2 p3 : ℝ} (he : 0 < e)
    (hrho : rho ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hh : |exactH p1 p2| ≤ 1/2) (hp3 : |p3| ≤ 1)
    (t : ScaledTrace e rho p1 p2 p3) (hguard : t.gapHat < -(32*e)) :
    exactR rho p1 p2 p3 < exactL p1 p2 p3 := by
  have herr := (scaled_errors (le_of_lt he) hrho hh hp3 t).2.2.2.2
  have h := guard_negative he herr hguard
  dsimp [exactG] at h
  linarith

name: ModAB.binary64Epsilon
source: def binary64Epsilon : ℝ := 1 / (2:ℝ)^53

name: ModAB.binary64Epsilon_pos
source: theorem binary64Epsilon_pos : 0 < binary64Epsilon := by norm_num [binary64Epsilon]

name: ModAB.binary64_guard_value
source:
theorem binary64_guard_value : 32*binary64Epsilon = 1/(2:ℝ)^48 := by
  norm_num [binary64Epsilon]

name: ModAB.originalL
source: def originalL (f1 f2 f3 : ℝ) : ℝ := |f3-(f1+f2)/2|

name: ModAB.originalR
source: def originalR (k f1 f2 f3 : ℝ) : ℝ := k*(|(f1+f2)/2|+|f3|)

name: ModAB.normalization_identity
source:
theorem normalization_identity {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (k f1 f2 f3 : ℝ) :
    k*(|(f1/s+f2/s)/2|+|f3/s|)-|f3/s-(f1/s+f2/s)/2| =
      (originalR k f1 f2 f3-originalL f1 f2 f3)/s := by
  have hm : (f1/s+f2/s)/2 = ((f1+f2)/2)/s := by ring
  have hl : f3/s - ((f1+f2)/2)/s = (f3-(f1+f2)/2)/s := by ring
  rw [hm, hl]
  dsimp [originalR, originalL]
  simp only [abs_div, abs_of_pos hs]
  ring

name: ModAB.normalization_sign
source:
theorem normalization_sign {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (k f1 f2 f3 : ℝ) :
    0 < k*(|(f1/s+f2/s)/2|+|f3/s|)-|f3/s-(f1/s+f2/s)/2| ↔
      originalL f1 f2 f3 < originalR k f1 f2 f3 := by
  rw [normalization_identity hs, div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hs, sub_pos]

name: ModAB.endpoint_ratio
source:
theorem endpoint_ratio {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    |(-a+b)/2|/(a+b) =
      (1-min a b/max a b)/(2*(1+min a b/max a b)) := by
  rcases le_total a b with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h, max_eq_right h, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ (-a+b)/2)]
    field_simp
    ; ring
  · rw [min_eq_right h, max_eq_left h, abs_of_nonpos (by linarith : (-a+b)/2 ≤ 0)]
    field_simp
    ; ring

name: ModAB.endpoint_rho_range
source:
theorem endpoint_rho_range {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    min a b/max a b ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 := by
  have hp : 0 < max a b := lt_of_lt_of_le ha (le_max_left _ _)
  constructor
  · apply div_nonneg
    · exact le_min (le_of_lt ha) (le_of_lt hb)
    · exact le_of_lt hp
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hp).mpr
    simpa only [one_mul] using le_trans (min_le_left a b) (le_max_left a b)

name: ModAB.endpoint_factor
source:
theorem endpoint_factor {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    (1-|(-a+b)/2|/(a+b))^2 = kappa (min a b/max a b) := by
  rw [endpoint_ratio ha hb, kappa_identity (endpoint_rho_range ha hb).1]

name: ModAB.normalized_midpoint_bound
source:
theorem normalized_midpoint_bound {p1 p2 : ℝ}
    (h1 : |p1| ≤ 1) (h2 : |p2| ≤ 1)
    (hsign : (p1 ≤ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ p2) ∨ (p2 ≤ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ p1)) :
    |exactH p1 p2| ≤ 1/2 := by
  rcases abs_le.mp h1 with ⟨h1l,h1u⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp h2 with ⟨h2l,h2u⟩
  apply abs_le.mpr
  dsimp [exactH]
  rcases hsign with ⟨ha,hb⟩ | ⟨ha,hb⟩ <;> constructor <;> linarith

name: ModAB.scaled_original_switch
source:
theorem scaled_original_switch {e rho f1 f2 f3 s : ℝ} (he : 0 < e) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hrho : rho ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hh : |exactH (f1/s) (f2/s)| ≤ 1/2) (hp3 : |f3/s| ≤ 1)
    (t : ScaledTrace e rho (f1/s) (f2/s) (f3/s)) (hguard : 32*e < t.gapHat) :
    originalL f1 f2 f3 < originalR (kappa rho) f1 f2 f3 := by
  apply (normalization_sign hs (kappa rho) f1 f2 f3).mp
  have h := certified_switch he hrho hh hp3 t hguard
  dsimp [exactL, exactR, exactH] at h
  linarith

name: ModAB.subnormal_exact_scaled_gap
source:
theorem subnormal_exact_scaled_gap :
    exactG (1/2) (-1/2) 1 (1/2) = (13/48:ℝ) := by
  norm_num [exactG, exactR, exactL, exactH, kappa, abs_of_nonneg]

name: ModAB.subnormal_margin
source:
theorem subnormal_margin : (57:ℝ)*binary64Epsilon < 13/48 := by
  norm_num [binary64Epsilon]

name: ModAB.symmetric_exact_gap
source:
theorem symmetric_exact_gap (z : ℝ) : exactG 1 (-1) 1 z = 0 := by
  norm_num [exactG, exactR, exactL, exactH, kappa]

name: ModAB.inputScale
source: def inputScale (a b z : ℝ) : ℝ := max (max a b) |z|

name: ModAB.inputScale_pos
source:
theorem inputScale_pos {a b z : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) : 0 < inputScale a b z := by
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le ha (le_trans (le_max_left a b) (le_max_left (max a b) |z|))

name: ModAB.normalized_input_bounds
source:
theorem normalized_input_bounds {a b z : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    |exactH (-a/inputScale a b z) (b/inputScale a b z)| ≤ 1/2 ∧
    |z/inputScale a b z| ≤ 1 := by
  let s := inputScale a b z
  have hs : 0 < s := inputScale_pos ha
  have haS : a ≤ s := le_trans (le_max_left a b) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hbS : b ≤ s := le_trans (le_max_right a b) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hzS : |z| ≤ s := le_max_right _ _
  have h1 : |-a/s| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_neg, abs_of_pos ha, abs_of_pos hs]
    exact (div_le_one hs).mpr haS
  have h2 : |b/s| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hb, abs_of_pos hs]
    exact (div_le_one hs).mpr hbS
  constructor
  · apply normalized_midpoint_bound h1 h2
    left
    constructor
    · exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) (le_of_lt hs)
    · exact div_nonneg (le_of_lt hb) (le_of_lt hs)
  · rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hs]
    exact (div_le_one hs).mpr hzS

name: ModAB.certified_from_residuals
source:
theorem certified_from_residuals {e a b z : ℝ} (he : 0 < e)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (t : ScaledTrace e (min a b/max a b)
      (-a/inputScale a b z) (b/inputScale a b z) (z/inputScale a b z))
    (hguard : 32*e < t.gapHat) :
    |z-(-a+b)/2| < (1-|(-a+b)/2|/(a+b))^2*(|(-a+b)/2|+|z|) := by
  rw [endpoint_factor ha hb]
  have hbds := normalized_input_bounds (z := z) ha hb
  exact scaled_original_switch he (inputScale_pos ha) (endpoint_rho_range ha hb)
    hbds.1 hbds.2 t hguard

name: ModAB.scaled_margin_guarantees
source:
theorem scaled_margin_guarantees {e rho p1 p2 p3 : ℝ} (he : 0 ≤ e)
    (hrho : rho ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hh : |exactH p1 p2| ≤ 1/2) (hp3 : |p3| ≤ 1)
    (t : ScaledTrace e rho p1 p2 p3) :
    (57*e < exactG rho p1 p2 p3 → 32*e < t.gapHat) ∧
    (exactG rho p1 p2 p3 < -(57*e) → t.gapHat < -(32*e)) := by
  have h := (scaled_errors he hrho hh hp3 t).2.2.2.2
  exact ⟨complete_positive h, complete_negative h⟩

name: ModAB.gamma
source: def gamma (j : ℕ) : ℝ := (j:ℝ)*binary64Epsilon/(1-(j:ℝ)*binary64Epsilon)

name: ModAB.unscaled_coefficient
source:
theorem unscaled_coefficient :
    (3+binary64Epsilon)/2*gamma 2 + 3*gamma 3 +
      (5*binary64Epsilon+binary64Epsilon^2)/2 < 16*binary64Epsilon := by
  norm_num [gamma, binary64Epsilon]

name: ModAB.unscaled_error_budget
source:
theorem unscaled_error_budget {L R l r H : ℝ} (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (hl : Within l L ((2*binary64Epsilon+binary64Epsilon^2/2)*H))
    (hr : Within r R (((3+binary64Epsilon)/2*gamma 2 +
      3*gamma 3 + binary64Epsilon/2)*H)) :
    Within (r-l) (R-L) (16*binary64Epsilon*H) := by
  have h := within_sub hr hl
  apply within_mono h
  have hc := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_of_lt unscaled_coefficient) hH
  nlinarith only [hc]

name: ModAB.Examples.phi_den_positive
source:
theorem phi_den_positive {e r : ℝ} (he : 0≤e) (hr : 0<r) :
    0<1+r+e*(1+2*r) := by positivity

name: ModAB.Examples.phi_hasDerivAt_ratio
source:
theorem phi_hasDerivAt_ratio {e r : ℝ} (he : 0≤e) (hr : 0<r) :
    HasDerivAt (phi e) (-(1+e)^2/(1+r+e*(1+2*r))^2) r := by
  have hn:= (hasDerivAt_const r (1:ℝ)).add
    (((hasDerivAt_const r (1:ℝ)).add (hasDerivAt_id r)).const_mul e)
  have hd:= ((hasDerivAt_const r (1:ℝ)).add (hasDerivAt_id r)).add
    (((hasDerivAt_const r (1:ℝ)).add ((hasDerivAt_id r).const_mul 2)).const_mul e)
  have h:=hn.div hd (ne_of_gt (phi_den_positive he hr))
  convert h using 1 <;> (try funext x) <;> (try dsimp [phi]) <;> field_simp <;> ring

name: ModAB.Examples.phi_hasDerivAt_error
source:
theorem phi_hasDerivAt_error {e r : ℝ} (he : 0≤e) (hr : 0<r) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t=>phi t r) (r^2/(1+r+e*(1+2*r))^2) e := by
  have hn:= (hasDerivAt_const e (1:ℝ)).add ((hasDerivAt_id e).mul_const (1+r))
  have hd:= (hasDerivAt_const e (1+r)).add ((hasDerivAt_id e).mul_const (1+2*r))
  have h:=hn.div hd (ne_of_gt (phi_den_positive he hr))
  convert h using 1 <;> (try funext x) <;> (try dsimp [phi]) <;> field_simp <;> ring

name: ModAB.Examples.phi_ratio_strictAntiOn
source:
theorem phi_ratio_strictAntiOn {e : ℝ} (he : 0≤e) :
    StrictAntiOn (phi e) (Icc (1/2:ℝ) (7/10)) := by
  apply strictAntiOn_of_deriv_neg (convex_Icc _ _)
  · intro r hr
    exact (phi_hasDerivAt_ratio he (by linarith [hr.1])).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  · intro r hr
    have hi:=interior_subset hr
    rw [(phi_hasDerivAt_ratio he (by linarith [hi.1])).deriv]
    apply div_neg_of_neg_of_pos
    · have hp : 0<(1+e)^2:=by positivity
      linarith
    · exact sq_pos_of_pos (phi_den_positive he (by linarith [hi.1]))

name: ModAB.Examples.phi_error_strictMonoOn
source:
theorem phi_error_strictMonoOn {r : ℝ} (hr : 0<r) :
    StrictMonoOn (fun e=>phi e r) (Icc (0:ℝ) (2/5)) := by
  apply strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (convex_Icc _ _)
  · intro e he
    exact (phi_hasDerivAt_error he.1 hr).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  · intro e he
    have hi:=interior_subset he
    rw [(phi_hasDerivAt_error hi.1 hr).deriv]
    exact div_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hr) (sq_pos_of_pos (phi_den_positive hi.1 hr))

name: ModAB.Examples.phi_region
source:
theorem phi_region {e r : ℝ} (he : e∈Icc (0:ℝ) (2/5))
    (hr : r∈Icc (1/2:ℝ) (7/10)) :
    (10/17:ℝ)≤phi e r ∧ phi e r≤16/23 := by
  have hl:= (phi_error_strictMonoOn (r:=7/10) (by norm_num)).monotoneOn
    (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)∈Icc 0 (2/5)) he he.1
  have hl':= (phi_ratio_strictAntiOn he.1).antitoneOn hr
    (by norm_num : (7/10:ℝ)∈Icc (1/2) (7/10)) hr.2
  have hu:= (phi_ratio_strictAntiOn he.1).antitoneOn
    (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ)∈Icc (1/2) (7/10)) hr hr.1
  have hu':= (phi_error_strictMonoOn (r:=1/2) (by norm_num)).monotoneOn he
    (by norm_num : (2/5:ℝ)∈Icc 0 (2/5)) he.2
  rw [show phi 0 (7/10)=10/17 by norm_num [phi]] at hl
  rw [show phi (2/5) (1/2)=16/23 by norm_num [phi]] at hu'
  exact ⟨hl.trans hl',hu.trans hu'⟩

name: ModAB.Examples.counterError

name: ModAB.Examples.counter_recurrence

theorem counter_recurrence (n : ℕ) :
    counterRatio (n+1)=phi (counterError n) (counterRatio n) ∧
    counterError (n+1)=counterError n*counterRatio (n+1) := by
  constructor <;> rfl

name: ModAB.Examples.counter_invariant
source:
theorem counter_invariant (n : ℕ) :
    0<counterError n ∧ counterError n≤2/5 ∧ counterRatio n∈Icc (1/2:ℝ) (7/10) := by
  induction n with
  | zero=>norm_num [counterError,counterRatio,counterPair]
  | succ n ih=>
    have hp:=phi_region ⟨ih.1.le,ih.2.1⟩ ih.2.2
    have hr : counterRatio (n+1)∈Icc (1/2:ℝ) (7/10):=by
      rw [(counter_recurrence n).1]
      constructor <;> linarith [hp.1,hp.2]
    have hpos : 0<counterRatio (n+1):=by linarith [hr.1]
    rw [(counter_recurrence n).2]
    exact ⟨mul_pos ih.1 hpos,by nlinarith [hr.2],hr⟩

name: ModAB.Examples.counterPrevious

def counterPrevious : ℕ→ℝ

name: ModAB.Examples.counter_ratio_identity
source:
theorem counter_ratio_identity (n : ℕ) :
    counterError n=counterRatio n*counterPrevious n := by
  cases n with
  | zero=>norm_num [counterError,counterRatio,counterPair,counterPrevious]
  | succ n=>simpa only [counterPrevious,mul_comm] using (counter_recurrence n).2

name: ModAB.Examples.counterPrevious_positive

name: ModAB.Examples.counterState
source:
def counterState (n : ℕ) : LeftState :=
  ⟨counterError n,(1+counterError n)*(counterPrevious n+counterError n),true⟩

name: ModAB.Examples.counter_trial_identity
source:
theorem counter_trial_identity {e p r : ℝ} (he : 0<e) (hp : 0<p) (hr : 0<r)
    (hrel : e=r*p) :
    leftTrial 2 e ((1+e)*(p+e))=e*phi e r := by
  have hd:=ne_of_gt (phi_den_positive he.le hr)
  have hv : (1+e)*(p+e)+e^2≠0:=by positivity
  simp only [leftTrial,phi]
  field_simp
  rw [hrel]
  ring

name: ModAB.Examples.counter_correction_identity
source:
theorem counter_correction_identity {e t v : ℝ} (he : 0<e)
    (hv : 0<v) (ht : t=leftTrial 2 e v) :
    v*(1-t^2/e^2)=(1+t)*(e+t) := by
  have hd : v+e^2≠0:=by positivity
  have hbalance : (e-t)*v=e^2*(1+t) := by
    rw [ht]
    dsimp [leftTrial]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hmul:=congrArg (fun x : ℝ=>x*(e+t)) hbalance
  field_simp
  nlinarith only [hmul]

name: ModAB.Examples.counter_state_step
source:
theorem counter_state_step (n : ℕ) : leftStep 2 (counterState n)=counterState (n+1) := by
  have hi:=counter_invariant n
  have hp:=counterPrevious_positive n
  have hr : 0<counterRatio n:=by linarith [hi.2.2.1]
  have hv : 0<(1+counterError n)*(counterPrevious n+counterError n):=
    mul_pos (by linarith [hi.1]) (by linarith [hi.1,hp])
  have ht:=counter_trial_identity hi.1 hp hr (counter_ratio_identity n)
  have ht' : leftTrial 2 (counterError n)
      ((1+counterError n)*(counterPrevious n+counterError n))=counterError (n+1) := by
    rw [ht,(counter_recurrence n).2,(counter_recurrence n).1]
  have hc:=counter_correction_identity hi.1 hv ht'.symm
  simp only [leftStep,counterState,ite_true]
  rw [ht',hc]
  rfl

name: ModAB.Examples.counter_orbit

name: ModAB.Examples.counter_actual_update

name: ModAB.Examples.counter_residual_ratio
source:
theorem counter_residual_ratio (n : ℕ) :
    |counterFunction (-counterError n)| /
      min |counterFunction (-counterPrevious n)| |counterFunction 1|≤49/100 := by
  have hp:=counterPrevious_positive n
  have hi:=counter_invariant n
  have hprev : counterPrevious n≤1:=by
    cases n with
    | zero=>norm_num [counterPrevious]
    | succ k=>exact le_trans (counter_invariant k).2.1 (by norm_num)
  rw [counterFunction_left hi.1.le,counterFunction_left hp.le]
  have hf : counterFunction 1=7:=by norm_num [counterFunction,gluedQuadratic]
  rw [hf,abs_neg,abs_neg,abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _),abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  norm_num only [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<7)]
  have hmin : min ((counterPrevious n)^2) (7:ℝ)=(counterPrevious n)^2:=by
    apply min_eq_left
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hp.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hprev)]
  rw [hmin,counter_ratio_identity n]
  have hid : (counterRatio n*counterPrevious n)^2/(counterPrevious n)^2=(counterRatio n)^2:=by
    field_simp
  rw [hid]
  nlinarith [hi.2.2.1,hi.2.2.2]

name: ModAB.Examples.counter_admissible_step
source:
theorem counter_admissible_step (n : ℕ) :
    -counterError (n+1)∈Ioo (-counterError n) 1 ∧
    counterFunction (-counterError (n+1))≠0 ∧
    0<1-(counterError (n+1))^2/(counterError n)^2 := by
  have he:=(counter_invariant n).1
  have hn:=(counter_invariant (n+1)).1
  have hs:=counter_error_shrinks n
  have hlt : counterError (n+1)<counterError n:=by linarith
  constructor
  · constructor <;> linarith
  · constructor
    · intro hz
      have heq:=(counterFunction_zero_iff _).mp hz
      linarith
    · have hsq : (counterError (n+1))^2<(counterError n)^2:=by nlinarith
      have hratio : (counterError (n+1))^2/(counterError n)^2<1:=
        (div_lt_one (sq_pos_of_pos he)).mpr hsq
      linarith

name: ModAB.Examples.counter_residual_exception
source:
theorem counter_residual_exception (n : ℕ) :
    |counterFunction (-counterError n)| < (1/2)*
      min |counterFunction (-counterPrevious n)| |counterFunction 1| := by
  have hp:=counterPrevious_positive n
  have hm : 0<min |counterFunction (-counterPrevious n)| |counterFunction 1| := by
    apply lt_min
    · rw [counterFunction_left hp.le,abs_neg,abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      exact sq_pos_of_pos hp
    · norm_num [counterFunction,gluedQuadratic]
  have hb:=counter_residual_ratio n
  have hm' := (div_le_iff₀ hm).mp hb
  nlinarith only [hm,hm']

name: ModAB.Examples.counter_width_test_fails

theorem counter_width_test_fails (n : ℕ) :
    ModAB.Convergence.threshold 2 2 (n+3)<1+counterError n := by
  have hp : (2:ℝ)^3≤2^(n+3):=pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hpow : 0<(2:ℝ)^(n+3):=by positivity
  have ht : ModAB.Convergence.threshold 2 2 (n+3)≤1:=by
    unfold ModAB.Convergence.threshold
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hpow).mpr
    norm_num at hp ⊢
    exact hp
  linarith [(counter_invariant n).1]

name: ModAB.Examples.counter_full_actual_update

    -counterFullError (j+1)∈Ioo (-counterFullError j) 1 ∧

name: ModAB.Examples.counter_uncapped_continues

theorem counter_uncapped_continues (j : ℕ) (hj : 1≤j) : uncappedContinues j := by
  rcases j with _|_|_|n
  · omega
  · left; norm_num [counterFullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial,ModAB.Convergence.threshold]
  · left; norm_num [counterFullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial,ModAB.Convergence.threshold]

name: ModAB.Unscaled.eps
source: abbrev eps : ℝ := binary64Epsilon

name: ModAB.Unscaled.minNormal
source: def minNormal : ℝ := (2:ℝ)^(-1022:ℤ)

name: ModAB.Unscaled.NormalOrZero
source: def NormalOrZero (x : ℝ) : Prop := x=0 ∨ minNormal≤|x|

name: ModAB.Unscaled.Relative
source:
def Relative (computed exact : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ δ : ℝ, |δ|≤eps ∧ computed=exact*(1+δ)

name: ModAB.Unscaled.eps_bounds
source:
theorem eps_bounds : 0<eps ∧ eps<1 ∧ 0<gamma 2 ∧ 0<gamma 3 ∧ gamma 3<1 := by
  norm_num [eps,binary64Epsilon,gamma]

name: ModAB.Unscaled.rounded_relative
source:
theorem rounded_relative {x : ℝ} (hx : NormalOrZero x) : Relative (Binary64.round x) x := by
  rcases hx with hz | hn
  · subst x; exact ⟨0,by simpa using le_of_lt binary64Epsilon_pos,by simp⟩
  have hp : 0<minNormal := by unfold minNormal; positivity
  have hx0 : x≠0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hn; linarith
  have hr := relative_error_round_FLT_normal (β := binaryRadix) (-1074) 53
    (by norm_num) nearestEven x hx0 (by simpa [minNormal,pow_value] using hn)
  refine ⟨(Binary64.round x-x)/x,?_,?_⟩
  · have hc : bpow binaryRadix (1-53)/2 = eps := by norm_num [pow_value,eps,binary64Epsilon]
    rw [hc] at hr
    simpa [ErrorBounds.relativeError,Binary64.round,exponent,abs_div] using hr
  · field_simp <;> ring

name: ModAB.Unscaled.relative_error
source:
theorem relative_error {a x : ℝ} (h : Relative a x) : Within a x (eps*|x|) := by
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,rfl⟩ := h
  unfold Within
  have he : x*(1+δ)-x=x*δ := by ring
  rw [he,abs_mul]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ (abs_nonneg x)]

name: ModAB.Unscaled.relative_abs
source:
theorem relative_abs {a x : ℝ} (h : Relative a x) : Relative |a| |x| := by
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,rfl⟩ := h
  have hd := (abs_le.mp hδ).1
  refine ⟨δ,hδ,?_⟩
  rw [abs_mul,abs_of_pos (by linarith [eps_bounds.2.1] : 0<1+δ)]

name: ModAB.Unscaled.normal_halving_exact
source:
theorem normal_halving_exact {x : ℝ} (hx : Representable x)
    (hn : NormalOrZero (x/2)) : Binary64.round (x/2)=x/2 := by
  rcases hn with h0 | hn
  · rw [h0,Binary64.round_zero]
  have hmin : (2:ℝ)^(-1021:ℤ) ≤ |x| := by
    have he : (2:ℝ)^(-1021:ℤ)=2*minNormal := by
      unfold minNormal; rw [show (-1021:ℤ)=1+(-1022) by omega, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num : (2:ℝ)≠0)]; norm_num
    rw [he]
    rw [abs_div,abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)] at hn
    linarith
  have hm := magnitude_mono_abs binaryRadix (by positivity : (2:ℝ)^(-1021:ℤ)≠0)
    (by simpa [abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0<(2:ℝ)^(-1021:ℤ))] using hmin)
  have hmag : magnitude binaryRadix ((2:ℝ)^(-1021:ℤ)) = -1020 := by
    rw [←pow_value]; simp
  rw [hmag] at hm
  have hf := generic_format_FLT_mul_bpow (β := binaryRadix)
    (-1074) 53 (by norm_num) hx (-1) (by omega)
  exact round_exact (by simpa [pow_value,div_eq_mul_inv] using hf)

name: ModAB.Unscaled.factor_two_bound
source:
theorem factor_two_bound {a b : ℝ} (ha : |a|≤eps) (hb : |b|≤eps) :
    |(1+a)*(1+b)-1|≤2*eps+eps^2 := by
  have hmul := product_error (x:=1) (x':=1+a) (y:=1) (y':=1+b)
    (A:=1+eps) (B:=eps) (C:=eps) (D:=1)
    ((abs_add_le 1 a).trans (by simpa using add_le_add_left ha 1))
    (by simpa [Within] using hb) (by simpa [Within] using ha) (by norm_num)
  convert hmul using 1 <;> (try unfold Within) <;> ring

name: ModAB.Unscaled.factor_two_gamma
source:
theorem factor_two_gamma {a b : ℝ} (ha : |a|≤eps) (hb : |b|≤eps) :
    |(1+a)*(1+b)-1|≤gamma 2 := by
  exact (factor_two_bound ha hb).trans (by norm_num [eps,binary64Epsilon,gamma])

name: ModAB.Unscaled.factor_three_gamma
source:
theorem factor_three_gamma {a b c : ℝ}
    (ha : |a|≤eps) (hb : |b|≤eps) (hc : |c|≤eps) :
    |(1+a)*(1+b)*(1+c)-1|≤gamma 3 := by
  have he : 0≤eps := le_of_lt eps_bounds.1
  have hab := factor_two_bound ha hb
  have habs : |(1+a)*(1+b)|≤(1+eps)^2 := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    have aa : |1+a|≤1+eps := (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by simpa using add_le_add_left ha 1)
    have bb : |1+b|≤1+eps := (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by simpa using add_le_add_left hb 1)
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul aa bb (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith : 0≤1+eps)]
  have hm := product_error (x:=1) (x':=(1+a)*(1+b)) (y:=1) (y':=1+c)
    habs (by simpa [Within] using hc) hab (by norm_num : |(1:ℝ)|≤1)
  apply (show |(1+a)*(1+b)*(1+c)-1|≤_ by simpa [Within] using hm).trans
  norm_num [eps,binary64Epsilon,gamma]

name: ModAB.Unscaled.factor_quotient_gamma
source:
theorem factor_quotient_gamma {a b c : ℝ}
    (ha : |a|≤eps) (hb : |b|≤eps) (hc : |c|≤eps) :
    |(1+a)*(1+c)/(1+b)-1|≤gamma 3 := by
  have hb0 : 0<1+b := by have h := (abs_le.mp hb).1; linarith [eps_bounds.2.1]
  have hden : 1-eps≤1+b := by have h := (abs_le.mp hb).1; linarith
  have hnum := within_sub (factor_two_bound ha hc) (by simpa [Within] using hb : Within (1+b) 1 eps)
  have hid : (1+a)*(1+c)/(1+b)-1=((1+a)*(1+c)-(1+b))/(1+b) := by field_simp
  rw [hid,abs_div,abs_of_pos hb0]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hb0).mpr
  have hconst : (2*eps+eps^2)+eps ≤ gamma 3*(1-eps) := by norm_num [eps,binary64Epsilon,gamma]
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hden (le_of_lt eps_bounds.2.2.2.1)
  simp only [Within,sub_self,sub_zero] at hnum
  linarith

name: ModAB.Unscaled.Values
source:
structure Values where
  (sum diff y v r k leftDiff productY productZ right : ℝ)

name: ModAB.Unscaled.evaluate
ModAB.Unscaled.arguments
source:
def arguments (f1 f2 f3 : ℝ) : List ℝ :=
  let t:=evaluate f1 f2 f3
  [f1+f2,f2-f1,t.sum/2,|t.y|/|t.diff|,1-t.v,t.r*t.r,
   f3-t.y,t.k*|t.y|,t.k*|f3|,t.productY+t.productZ]

name: ModAB.Unscaled.NormalRun
source:
structure NormalRun (f1 f2 f3 : ℝ) : Prop where
  sum : NormalOrZero (f1+f2)
  diff : NormalOrZero (f2-f1)
  half : NormalOrZero ((evaluate f1 f2 f3).sum/2)
  quotient : NormalOrZero (|(evaluate f1 f2 f3).y|/|(evaluate f1 f2 f3).diff|)
  subtract : NormalOrZero (1-(evaluate f1 f2 f3).v)
  square : NormalOrZero ((evaluate f1 f2 f3).r*(evaluate f1 f2 f3).r)
  left : NormalOrZero (f3-(evaluate f1 f2 f3).y)
  productY : NormalOrZero ((evaluate f1 f2 f3).k*|(evaluate f1 f2 f3).y|)
  productZ : NormalOrZero ((evaluate f1 f2 f3).k*|f3|)
  right : NormalOrZero ((evaluate f1 f2 f3).productY+(evaluate f1 f2 f3).productZ)

name: ModAB.Unscaled.NoOverflow
source:
def NoOverflow (f1 f2 f3 : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x∈arguments f1 f2 f3, Finite (Binary64.round x)

name: ModAB.Unscaled.midpoint_relative
source:
theorem midpoint_relative {f1 f2 f3 : ℝ} (hn : NormalRun f1 f2 f3) :
    Relative (evaluate f1 f2 f3).y ((f1+f2)/2) := by
  obtain ⟨δ,hd,hs⟩ := rounded_relative hn.sum
  have hh := normal_halving_exact (round_representable (f1+f2)) hn.half
  refine ⟨δ,hd,?_⟩
  change Binary64.round (Binary64.round (f1+f2)/2)=_
  rw [hh,hs]; ring

name: ModAB.Unscaled.quotient_error
source:
theorem quotient_error {f1 f2 f3 : ℝ} (hs : f1*f2<0) (hn : NormalRun f1 f2 f3) :
    Within (evaluate f1 f2 f3).v (|(f1+f2)/2|/|f2-f1|)
      (gamma 3*(|(f1+f2)/2|/|f2-f1|)) := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hy⟩ := relative_abs (midpoint_relative hn)
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hd⟩ := relative_abs (rounded_relative hn.diff)
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hv⟩ := rounded_relative hn.quotient
  have hp : 0 < |f2-f1| := Cubic.endpoint_difference_pos hs
  have hb0 : 0<1+b := by have h := (abs_le.mp hb).1; linarith [eps_bounds.2.1]
  have hformula : (evaluate f1 f2 f3).v =
      (|(f1+f2)/2|/|f2-f1|)*((1+a)*(1+c)/(1+b)) := by
    change Binary64.round (_/_)=_ at hv
    change Binary64.round (|(evaluate f1 f2 f3).y|/|(evaluate f1 f2 f3).diff|)=_
    rw [hv,hy]
    change |Binary64.round (f2-f1)|=_ at hd
    change (|(f1+f2)/2| *(1+a)/|Binary64.round (f2-f1)|)*(1+c)=_
    rw [hd]; field_simp <;> ring
  unfold Within
  rw [hformula]
  have hq : 0≤|(f1+f2)/2|/|f2-f1| := by positivity
  have hid : (|(f1+f2)/2|/|f2-f1|)*((1+a)*(1+c)/(1+b))-
      |(f1+f2)/2|/|f2-f1| =
      (|(f1+f2)/2|/|f2-f1|)*((1+a)*(1+c)/(1+b)-1) := by ring
  rw [hid,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg hq]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (factor_quotient_gamma ha hb hc) hq]

name: ModAB.Unscaled.factor_ranges
source:
theorem factor_ranges {f1 f2 f3 : ℝ} (hs : f1*f2<0) (hn : NormalRun f1 f2 f3) :
    let t:=evaluate f1 f2 f3
    0≤t.v ∧ t.v<1 ∧ t.r∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ∧ t.k∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 := by
  let t:=evaluate f1 f2 f3
  have hv0 : 0≤t.v := by
    change 0 ≤ Binary64.round (|t.y|/|t.diff|)
    have h := round_monotone (show (0:ℝ)≤|t.y|/|t.diff| by positivity)
    simpa only [Binary64.round_zero] using h
  have hv := quotient_error hs hn
  have vr := Cubic.ratio_range hs
  have hvl := (abs_le.mp hv).2
  have hv1 : t.v<1 := by
    have hgam := eps_bounds.2.2.2
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left vr.2 hgam.1.le
    change t.v- (|(f1+f2)/2|/|f2-f1|) ≤ _ at hvl
    nlinarith
  have hr : t.r∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 := by
    change Binary64.round (1-t.v)∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1
    exact round_interval Binary64.round_zero Binary64.round_one
      (show 1-t.v∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 by constructor <;> linarith)
  have hk : t.k∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 := by
    change Binary64.round (t.r*t.r)∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1
    exact round_interval Binary64.round_zero Binary64.round_one
      (show t.r*t.r∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 by constructor <;> nlinarith [hr.1,hr.2])
  exact ⟨hv0,hv1,hr,hk⟩

name: ModAB.Unscaled.factor_error
source:
theorem factor_error {f1 f2 f3 : ℝ} (hs : f1*f2<0) (hn : NormalRun f1 f2 f3) :
    Within (evaluate f1 f2 f3).k ((1-|(f1+f2)/2|/|f2-f1|)^2) (2*gamma 3) := by
  let t:=evaluate f1 f2 f3
  let v:=|(f1+f2)/2|/|f2-f1|
  obtain ⟨d,hd,hr⟩ := rounded_relative hn.subtract
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hk⟩ := rounded_relative hn.square
  have hmodel : t.k=(1-t.v)^2*((1+d)*(1+d)*(1+c)) := by
    change t.r=(1-t.v)*(1+d) at hr
    change t.k=(t.r*t.r)*(1+c) at hk
    rw [hk,hr]; ring
  have tr := factor_ranges hs hn
  have vr := Cubic.ratio_range hs
  have hh : 0≤(1-t.v)^2 ∧ (1-t.v)^2≤1 := by
    constructor
    · positivity
    · nlinarith [tr.1,tr.2.1]
  have hlocal : Within t.k ((1-t.v)^2) (gamma 3) := by
    unfold Within
    rw [hmodel]
    have hid : (1-t.v)^2*((1+d)*(1+d)*(1+c))-(1-t.v)^2 =
        (1-t.v)^2*((1+d)*(1+d)*(1+c)-1) := by ring
    rw [hid,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg hh.1]
    have hg := factor_three_gamma hd hd hc
    have hm := mul_le_mul hh.2 hg (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1)
    simpa using hm
  have hq := quotient_error hs hn
  have hrerr := within_sub (within_refl (1:ℝ)) hq
  have hsquare := square_error
    (x:=1-t.v) (y:=1-v)
    (by constructor <;> linarith [tr.1,tr.2.1])
    (by constructor <;> dsimp [v] <;> linarith [vr.1,vr.2]) hrerr
  have h := within_trans hlocal hsquare
  apply within_mono h
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left vr.2 (le_of_lt eps_bounds.2.2.2.1)
  dsimp [v] at *
  linarith

name: ModAB.Unscaled.distributed_error
source:
theorem distributed_error {a b A B R : ℝ} (ha : 0≤a) (hb : 0≤b)
    (hA : Relative A a) (hB : Relative B b) (hR : Relative R (A+B)) :
    Within R (a+b) (gamma 2*(a+b)) := by
  obtain ⟨d,hd,rfl⟩ := hA
  obtain ⟨e,he,rfl⟩ := hB
  obtain ⟨c,hc,rfl⟩ := hR
  unfold Within
  have hid : (a*(1+d)+b*(1+e))*(1+c)-(a+b)=
      a*((1+d)*(1+c)-1)+b*((1+e)*(1+c)-1) := by ring
  rw [hid]
  calc
    |a*((1+d)*(1+c)-1)+b*((1+e)*(1+c)-1)| ≤
      |a*((1+d)*(1+c)-1)|+|b*((1+e)*(1+c)-1)| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ = a*|(1+d)*(1+c)-1|+b*|(1+e)*(1+c)-1| := by
      rw [abs_mul,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg ha,abs_of_nonneg hb]
    _ ≤ a*gamma 2+b*gamma 2 := add_le_add
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (factor_two_gamma hd hc) ha)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (factor_two_gamma he hc) hb)
    _ = gamma 2*(a+b) := by ring

name: ModAB.Unscaled.side_errors
source:
theorem side_errors {f1 f2 f3 : ℝ} (hs : f1*f2<0) (hn : NormalRun f1 f2 f3) :
    let t:=evaluate f1 f2 f3
    let H:=max |f2-f1| |f3|
    let k:=(1-|(f1+f2)/2|/|f2-f1|)^2
    Within |t.leftDiff| (originalL f1 f2 f3) ((2*eps+eps^2/2)*H) ∧
    Within t.right (originalR k f1 f2 f3)
      (((3+eps)/2*gamma 2+3*gamma 3+eps/2)*H) := by
  let t:=evaluate f1 f2 f3
  let y:=(f1+f2)/2
  let H:=max |f2-f1| |f3|
  let k:=(1-|(f1+f2)/2|/|f2-f1|)^2
  have hH : 0≤H := (abs_nonneg (f2-f1)).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hyH : |y|≤H/2 := (Cubic.midpoint_bound hs).trans (by
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (by norm_num))
  have hzH : |f3|≤H := le_max_right _ _
  have he : 0≤eps := le_of_lt eps_bounds.1
  have hy : Within t.y y (eps*|y|) := relative_error (midpoint_relative hn)
  have hyabs : |t.y|≤(1+eps)*|y| := by
    have hh := abs_add_le (t.y-y) y
    simp only [sub_add_cancel] at hh
    have hy' : |t.y-y|≤eps*|y| :=hy
    nlinarith [hy']
  have hyscaled : |t.y|≤(1+eps)*H/2 := by
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyH (by linarith : 0≤1+eps)
    nlinarith
  have tr := factor_ranges hs hn
  have hkrange : |t.k|≤1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg tr.2.2.2.1]; exact tr.2.2.2.2
  have hk : Within t.k k (2*gamma 3) := factor_error hs hn
  have hleft := within_abs (within_trans
    (relative_error (rounded_relative hn.left)) (within_sub (within_refl f3) hy))
  have hleftabs : |f3-t.y|≤H+(1+eps)*H/2 :=
    (abs_sub _ _).trans (add_le_add hzH hyscaled)
  have hleftbound : eps*|f3-t.y|+(0+eps*|y|)≤(2*eps+eps^2/2)*H := by
    have hm1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hleftabs he
    have hm2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyH he
    nlinarith only [hm1,hm2]
  have hsum : Within (|t.y|+|f3|) (|y|+|f3|) (eps*|y|) := by
    simpa using within_add (within_abs hy) (within_refl |f3|)
  have hpert := product_error hkrange hsum hk
    (show |(|y|+|f3|)|≤3*H/2 by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]; linarith)
  have hdist := distributed_error
    (a:=t.k*|t.y|) (b:=t.k*|f3|)
    (mul_nonneg tr.2.2.2.1 (abs_nonneg _))
    (mul_nonneg tr.2.2.2.1 (abs_nonneg _))
    (rounded_relative hn.productY) (rounded_relative hn.productZ) (rounded_relative hn.right)
  have hdist' : Within t.right (t.k*(|t.y|+|f3|))
      (gamma 2*(t.k*(|t.y|+|f3|))) := by
    change Within t.right (t.k*|t.y|+t.k*|f3|)
      (gamma 2*(t.k*|t.y|+t.k*|f3|)) at hdist
    simpa only [mul_add] using hdist
  have hsumH : t.k*(|t.y|+|f3|)≤(3+eps)*H/2 := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right tr.2.2.2.2
      (show 0≤|t.y|+|f3| by positivity)
    nlinarith only [hmul,hyscaled,hzH]
  have hright := within_trans hdist' hpert
  have hrbound : gamma 2*(t.k*(|t.y|+|f3|))+
      (1*(eps*|y|)+(2*gamma 3)*(3*H/2)) ≤
      (((3+eps)/2*gamma 2+3*gamma 3+eps/2)*H) := by
    have hm1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsumH (le_of_lt eps_bounds.2.2.1)
    have hm2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyH he
    nlinarith only [hm1,hm2]
  exact ⟨within_mono hleft hleftbound,within_mono hright hrbound⟩

name: ModAB.Unscaled.unscaled_error
source:
theorem unscaled_error {f1 f2 f3 : ℝ} (hs : f1*f2<0)
    (hn : NormalRun f1 f2 f3) (_hf : NoOverflow f1 f2 f3) :
    let t:=evaluate f1 f2 f3
    let H:=max |f2-f1| |f3|
    let k:=(1-|(f1+f2)/2|/|f2-f1|)^2
    Within (t.right-|t.leftDiff|)
      (originalR k f1 f2 f3-originalL f1 f2 f3) (16*eps*H) := by
  have h := side_errors hs hn
  exact unscaled_error_budget
    ((abs_nonneg (f2-f1)).trans (le_max_left _ _)) h.1 h.2

name: ModAB.Unscaled.comparison_agreement
source:
theorem comparison_agreement {G g m : ℝ} (hm : 0≤m)
    (he : Within g G m) (hmargin : m< |G|) : (0<g ↔ 0<G) := by
  rcases abs_le.mp he with ⟨hlo,hhi⟩
  by_cases hG : 0<G
  · rw [abs_of_pos hG] at hmargin
    constructor
    · exact fun _ => hG
    · intro _; linarith
  · have hGn : G≤0 := le_of_not_gt hG
    rw [abs_of_nonpos hGn] at hmargin
    constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: ModAB.Unscaled.unscaled_comparison
source:
theorem unscaled_comparison {f1 f2 f3 : ℝ} (hs : f1*f2<0)
    (hn : NormalRun f1 f2 f3) (hf : NoOverflow f1 f2 f3)
    (hmargin : 16*eps*(max |f2-f1| |f3|) <
      |originalR ((1-|(f1+f2)/2|/|f2-f1|)^2) f1 f2 f3-originalL f1 f2 f3|) :
    |(evaluate f1 f2 f3).leftDiff| < (evaluate f1 f2 f3).right ↔
    originalL f1 f2 f3 < originalR ((1-|(f1+f2)/2|/|f2-f1|)^2) f1 f2 f3 := by
  have heps : 0<eps :=eps_bounds.1
  have hmax : 0≤max |f2-f1| |f3| := (abs_nonneg _).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have h := comparison_agreement
    (by positivity : 0≤16*eps*(max |f2-f1| |f3|)) (unscaled_error hs hn hf) hmargin
  simpa only [sub_pos] using h

name: ModAB.Convergence.EndpointSide
source:
inductive EndpointSide where
  | left | right
  deriving DecidableEq

name: ModAB.Convergence.abFactor
source:
def abFactor (new old : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if 0 < 1-new/old then 1-new/old else 1/2

name: ModAB.Convergence.abFactor_positive
source:
theorem abFactor_positive (new old : ℝ) : 0 < abFactor new old := by
  unfold abFactor
  split_ifs with h
  · exact h
  · norm_num

name: ModAB.Convergence.OrdinateState
source:
structure OrdinateState where
  leftTrue : ℝ
  rightTrue : ℝ
  leftWork : ℝ
  rightWork : ℝ
  previous : Option EndpointSide

name: ModAB.Convergence.recordUpdate
source:
def recordUpdate (s : OrdinateState) (moved : EndpointSide) (y : ℝ) : OrdinateState :=
  match moved with
  | .left => ⟨y,s.rightTrue,y,
      (if s.previous = some .left then abFactor y s.leftWork else 1)*s.rightWork,
      some .left⟩
  | .right => ⟨s.leftTrue,y,
      (if s.previous = some .right then abFactor y s.rightWork else 1)*s.leftWork,y,
      some .right⟩

name: ModAB.Convergence.recorded_side
source:
theorem recorded_side (s : OrdinateState) (moved : EndpointSide) (y : ℝ) :
    (recordUpdate s moved y).previous = some moved := by cases moved <;> rfl

name: ModAB.Convergence.opposite_side_no_correction
source:
theorem opposite_side_no_correction (a b u v y : ℝ) :
    recordUpdate ⟨a,b,u,v,some .left⟩ .right y = ⟨a,y,u,y,some .right⟩ ∧
    recordUpdate ⟨a,b,u,v,some .right⟩ .left y = ⟨y,b,y,v,some .left⟩ := by
  simp [recordUpdate]

name: ModAB.Convergence.same_side_correction
source:
theorem same_side_correction (a b u v y : ℝ) :
    (recordUpdate ⟨a,b,u,v,some .left⟩ .left y).rightWork = abFactor y u*v ∧
    (recordUpdate ⟨a,b,u,v,some .right⟩ .right y).leftWork = abFactor y v*u := by
  simp [recordUpdate]

name: ModAB.Convergence.recordUpdate_working_signs
source:
theorem recordUpdate_working_signs (s : OrdinateState) (moved : EndpointSide) (y : ℝ)
    (hu : SameSign s.leftWork s.leftTrue) (hv : SameSign s.rightWork s.rightTrue)
    (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    SameSign (recordUpdate s moved y).leftWork (recordUpdate s moved y).leftTrue ∧
    SameSign (recordUpdate s moved y).rightWork (recordUpdate s moved y).rightTrue := by
  have hp (old : ℝ) (side : EndpointSide) :
      0 < (if s.previous = some side then abFactor y old else 1) := by
    split_ifs
    · exact abFactor_positive y old
    · norm_num
  cases moved with
  | left => exact ⟨inserted_sign hy,positive_correction hv (hp _ _)⟩
  | right => exact ⟨positive_correction hu (hp _ _),inserted_sign hy⟩

name: ModAB.Convergence.top_entry_ordinates
source:
theorem top_entry_ordinates (a b y : ℝ) :
    recordUpdate ⟨a,b,a,b,none⟩ .left y = ⟨y,b,y,b,some .left⟩ ∧
    recordUpdate ⟨a,b,a,b,none⟩ .right y = ⟨a,y,a,y,some .right⟩ := by
  simp [recordUpdate]

name: ModAB.Convergence.top_entry_width_policy
source:
theorem top_entry_width_policy {B W : ℝ} (hB : (1/2:ℝ) ≤ B) (hW : 0 ≤ W) (M : ℕ) :
    W/2 ≤ B*W ∧ (B*W)/2 = threshold B (W/2) 1 ∧
    Step B M W .bisection (W/2) (.ab (W/2) 0 0) := by
  refine ⟨?_,?_,Step.bisectStart W⟩
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hB) hW]
  · simp [threshold]; ring

name: ModAB.Convergence.top_entry_midpoint
source:
theorem top_entry_midpoint :
    ((-3:ℝ)+1)/2 = -1 ∧ (1:ℝ)-(-1)=2 := by norm_num

name: ModAB.Convergence.top_left_seed
source:
theorem top_left_seed (a v : ℝ) :
    recordUpdate ⟨a,v,a,v,none⟩ .left (-1) = ⟨-1,v,-1,v,some .left⟩ :=
  (top_entry_ordinates a v (-1)).1

name: ModAB.Examples.topOneError
source:
def topOneError : ℕ→ℝ
  | 0 => 1/3
  | n+1 => quadraticMap (topOneError n)

name: ModAB.Examples.topOneState
source: def topOneState (n : ℕ) : LeftState := ⟨topOneError n,1+topOneError n,true⟩

name: ModAB.Examples.topOne_positive
source:
theorem topOne_positive (n : ℕ) : 0<topOneError n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num [topOneError]

name: ModAB.Examples.topOne_step

name: ModAB.Examples.topOne_first_steps

theorem topOne_first_steps :
    leftOrbit 1 ⟨1,2,true⟩ 1=topOneState 0 ∧
    topOneError 1=1/15 ∧ topOneError 2=1/255 ∧ topOneError 3=1/65535 := by
  norm_num [leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial,topOneState,topOneError,quadraticMap]

name: ModAB.Examples.topOne_orbit

theorem topOne_orbit (n : ℕ) : leftOrbit 1 ⟨1,2,true⟩ (n+1)=topOneState n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact topOne_first_steps.1

name: ModAB.Examples.topOne_tendsto
source:
theorem topOne_tendsto : Tendsto topOneError atTop (𝓝 0) :=
  geometric_tendsto (fun n=>(topOne_positive n).le) (by norm_num)
    (by norm_num) (fun n=>quadraticMap_half (topOne_positive n).le)

name: ModAB.Examples.topOne_quadratic_order
source:
theorem topOne_quadratic_order :
    Tendsto (fun n=>topOneError (n+1)/(topOneError n)^2) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  have hq (n : ℕ) : topOneError (n+1)/(topOneError n)^2=1/(1+2*topOneError n) := by
    have he:=ne_of_gt (topOne_positive n)
    simp only [topOneError,quadraticMap]
    field_simp
  simp_rw [hq]
  have ht := (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ=>(1:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 1)).div
    ((topOne_tendsto.const_mul 2).const_add 1) (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)+2*0≠0)
  change Tendsto (fun n=>(1:ℝ)/(1+2*topOneError n)) atTop (𝓝 (1/(1+2*(0:ℝ)))) at ht
  simpa only [mul_zero,add_zero,div_one,one_div] using ht

name: ModAB.Examples.topOneFullError
source: def topOneFullError (j : ℕ) : ℝ := (leftOrbit 1 ⟨1,2,true⟩ j).e

name: ModAB.Examples.topOne_full_tail
source:

name: ModAB.Examples.topOne_full_positive
source:
theorem topOne_full_positive (j : ℕ) : 0<topOneFullError j := by
  cases j with
  | zero => norm_num [topOneFullError,leftOrbit]
  | succ n => rw [topOne_full_tail]; exact topOne_positive n

name: ModAB.Examples.topOne_full_decrease
source:
theorem topOne_full_decrease (j : ℕ) : topOneFullError (j+1)<topOneFullError j := by
  cases j with
  | zero => norm_num [topOneFullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial]
  | succ n =>
    rw [topOne_full_tail,topOne_full_tail]
    change quadraticMap (topOneError n)<topOneError n
    linarith [quadraticMap_half (topOne_positive n).le,topOne_positive n]

name: ModAB.Examples.topOne_width_limit

  simpa only [topOne_full_tail,add_zero] using topOne_tendsto.const_add 1

name: ModAB.Examples.topOne_actual_update
source:
theorem topOne_actual_update (j : ℕ) :
    ModAB.Convergence.Updated oneFunction (-topOneFullError j) 1
      (-topOneFullError (j+1)) (-topOneFullError (j+1)) 1 ∧
    -topOneFullError (j+1)∈Ioo (-topOneFullError j) 1 ∧
    oneFunction (-topOneFullError (j+1))≠0 ∧
    0<1-topOneFullError (j+1)/topOneFullError j := by
  have he:=topOne_full_positive j
  have hn:=topOne_full_positive (j+1)
  have hd:=topOne_full_decrease j
  refine ⟨left_updated (p:=1) he hn (by simpa using oneFunction_left he.le)
    (by simpa using oneFunction_left hn.le),⟨by linarith,by linarith⟩,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [oneFunction_left hn.le]; linarith
  · linarith [(div_lt_one he).mpr hd]

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounterPair

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounterError
source: def topCounterError (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (topCounterPair n).1

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounterRatio
source: def topCounterRatio (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (topCounterPair n).2

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_recurrence
source:
theorem topCounter_recurrence (n : ℕ) :
    topCounterRatio (n+1)=phi (topCounterError n) (topCounterRatio n) ∧
    topCounterError (n+1)=topCounterError n*topCounterRatio (n+1) := by
  constructor <;> rfl

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_invariant
source:
theorem topCounter_invariant (n : ℕ) :
    0<topCounterError n ∧ topCounterError n≤2/5 ∧ topCounterRatio n∈Icc (1/2:ℝ) (7/10) := by
  induction n with
  | zero=>norm_num [topCounterError,topCounterRatio,topCounterPair]
  | succ n ih=>
    have hp:=phi_region ⟨ih.1.le,ih.2.1⟩ ih.2.2
    have hr : topCounterRatio (n+1)∈Icc (1/2:ℝ) (7/10):=by
      rw [(topCounter_recurrence n).1]
      constructor <;> linarith [hp.1,hp.2]
    have hpos : 0<topCounterRatio (n+1):=by linarith [hr.1]
    rw [(topCounter_recurrence n).2]
    exact ⟨mul_pos ih.1 hpos,by nlinarith [hr.2],hr⟩

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_error_shrinks
source:
theorem topCounter_error_shrinks (n : ℕ) :
    topCounterError (n+1)≤(7/10)*topCounterError n := by
  rw [(topCounter_recurrence n).2]
  nlinarith [(topCounter_invariant n).1,(topCounter_invariant (n+1)).2.2.2]

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounterPrevious

def topCounterPrevious : ℕ→ℝ

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_ratio_identity
source:
theorem topCounter_ratio_identity (n : ℕ) :
    topCounterError n=topCounterRatio n*topCounterPrevious n := by
  cases n with
  | zero=>norm_num [topCounterError,topCounterRatio,topCounterPair,topCounterPrevious]
  | succ n=>simpa only [topCounterPrevious,mul_comm] using (topCounter_recurrence n).2

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounterPrevious_positive

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounterState
source:
def topCounterState (n : ℕ) : LeftState :=
  ⟨topCounterError n,(1+topCounterError n)*(topCounterPrevious n+topCounterError n),true⟩

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_state_step
source:
theorem topCounter_state_step (n : ℕ) : leftStep 2 (topCounterState n)=topCounterState (n+1) := by
  have hi:=topCounter_invariant n
  have hp:=topCounterPrevious_positive n
  have hr : 0<topCounterRatio n:=by linarith [hi.2.2.1]
  have hv : 0<(1+topCounterError n)*(topCounterPrevious n+topCounterError n):=
    mul_pos (by linarith [hi.1]) (by linarith [hi.1,hp])
  have ht:=counter_trial_identity hi.1 hp hr (topCounter_ratio_identity n)
  have ht' : leftTrial 2 (topCounterError n)
      ((1+topCounterError n)*(topCounterPrevious n+topCounterError n))=topCounterError (n+1) := by
    rw [ht,(topCounter_recurrence n).2,(topCounter_recurrence n).1]
  have hc:=counter_correction_identity hi.1 hv ht'.symm
  simp only [leftStep,topCounterState,ite_true]
  rw [ht',hc]
  rfl

    leftOrbit 2 ⟨1,7,true⟩ 3=topCounterState 0 := by

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_orbit
source:
theorem topCounter_orbit (n : ℕ) : leftOrbit 2 ⟨1,7,true⟩ (n+3)=topCounterState n := by
  induction n with
  | zero=>exact topCounter_first_steps.2.2
  | succ n ih=>
    change leftStep 2 (leftOrbit 2 ⟨1,7,true⟩ (n+3))=topCounterState (n+1)
    rw [ih]
    exact topCounter_state_step n

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_actual_update
source:
theorem topCounter_actual_update (n : ℕ) :
    ModAB.Convergence.Updated counterFunction (-topCounterError n) 1
      (-topCounterError (n+1)) (-topCounterError (n+1)) 1 := by
  exact left_updated (p:=2) (topCounter_invariant n).1 (topCounter_invariant (n+1)).1
    (counterFunction_left (topCounter_invariant n).1.le)
    (counterFunction_left (topCounter_invariant (n+1)).1.le)

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_residual_ratio
source:
theorem topCounter_residual_ratio (n : ℕ) :
    |counterFunction (-topCounterError n)| /
      min |counterFunction (-topCounterPrevious n)| |counterFunction 1|≤49/100 := by
  have hp:=topCounterPrevious_positive n
  have hi:=topCounter_invariant n
  have hprev : topCounterPrevious n≤1:=by
    cases n with
    | zero=>norm_num [topCounterPrevious]
    | succ k=>exact le_trans (topCounter_invariant k).2.1 (by norm_num)
  rw [counterFunction_left hi.1.le,counterFunction_left hp.le]
  have hf : counterFunction 1=7:=by norm_num [counterFunction,gluedQuadratic]
  rw [hf,abs_neg,abs_neg,abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _),abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  norm_num only [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<7)]
  have hmin : min ((topCounterPrevious n)^2) (7:ℝ)=(topCounterPrevious n)^2:=by
    apply min_eq_left
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hp.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hprev)]
  rw [hmin,topCounter_ratio_identity n]
  have hid : (topCounterRatio n*topCounterPrevious n)^2/(topCounterPrevious n)^2=(topCounterRatio n)^2:=by
    field_simp
  rw [hid]
  nlinarith [hi.2.2.1,hi.2.2.2]

    counterFunction (-3)=-9 ∧ counterFunction 1=7 ∧ counterFunction (-1)=-1 ∧

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_admissible_step
source:
theorem topCounter_admissible_step (n : ℕ) :
    -topCounterError (n+1)∈Ioo (-topCounterError n) 1 ∧
    counterFunction (-topCounterError (n+1))≠0 ∧
    0<1-(topCounterError (n+1))^2/(topCounterError n)^2 := by
  have he:=(topCounter_invariant n).1
  have hn:=(topCounter_invariant (n+1)).1
  have hs:=topCounter_error_shrinks n
  have hlt : topCounterError (n+1)<topCounterError n:=by linarith
  constructor
  · constructor <;> linarith
  · constructor
    · intro hz
      have heq:=(counterFunction_zero_iff _).mp hz
      linarith
    · have hsq : (topCounterError (n+1))^2<(topCounterError n)^2:=by nlinarith
      have hratio : (topCounterError (n+1))^2/(topCounterError n)^2<1:=
        (div_lt_one (sq_pos_of_pos he)).mpr hsq
      linarith

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_residual_exception
source:
theorem topCounter_residual_exception (n : ℕ) :
    |counterFunction (-topCounterError n)| < (1/2)*
      min |counterFunction (-topCounterPrevious n)| |counterFunction 1| := by
  have hp:=topCounterPrevious_positive n
  have hm : 0<min |counterFunction (-topCounterPrevious n)| |counterFunction 1| := by
    apply lt_min
    · rw [counterFunction_left hp.le,abs_neg,abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      exact sq_pos_of_pos hp
    · norm_num [counterFunction,gluedQuadratic]
  have hb:=topCounter_residual_ratio n
  have hm' := (div_le_iff₀ hm).mp hb
  nlinarith only [hm,hm']

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_width_test_fails
source:
theorem topCounter_width_test_fails (n : ℕ) :
    ModAB.Convergence.threshold 2 2 (n+3)<1+topCounterError n := by
  have hp : (2:ℝ)^3≤2^(n+3):=pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hpow : 0<(2:ℝ)^(n+3):=by positivity
  have ht : ModAB.Convergence.threshold 2 2 (n+3)≤1:=by
    unfold ModAB.Convergence.threshold
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hpow).mpr
    norm_num at hp ⊢
    exact hp
  linarith [(topCounter_invariant n).1]

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_uncapped_continues

theorem topCounter_uncapped_continues (j : ℕ) (hj : 1≤j) : topUncappedContinues j := by
  rcases j with _|_|_|n
  · omega
  · left; norm_num [topCounterFullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial,ModAB.Convergence.threshold]
  · left; norm_num [topCounterFullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial,ModAB.Convergence.threshold]
  · right
    have hp : topCounterFullError (n+3-1)=topCounterPrevious n := by
      cases n with
      | zero=>norm_num [topCounterFullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial,topCounterPrevious]
      | succ n=>
        rw [show n+1+3-1=n+3 by omega,topCounter_full_tail]
        rfl
    rw [topCounter_full_tail,hp]
    exact topCounter_residual_exception n

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42Function
source: def eta42Function (x : ℝ) : ℝ := x+gluedQuadratic 0 (1/10) x

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_formula
source:
theorem eta42_formula (x : ℝ) :
    eta42Function x = if x≤0 then x else x+x^2/10 := by
  unfold eta42Function gluedQuadratic
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_C1
source:
theorem eta42_C1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 eta42Function :=
  contDiff_id.add (gluedQuadratic_C1 0 (1/10))

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_left
source:
theorem eta42_left {e : ℝ} (he : 0≤e) : eta42Function (-e) = -e := by
  rw [eta42_formula,if_pos (by linarith)]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_right
source: theorem eta42_right : eta42Function 1 = 11/10 := by norm_num [eta42_formula]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_zero_iff
source:
theorem eta42_zero_iff (x : ℝ) : eta42Function x=0 ↔ x=0 := by
  rw [eta42_formula]
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · constructor
    · intro hz; nlinarith [sq_nonneg x]
    · intro hz; simp [hz]

  convert (hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).add

  funext x
  simp [eta42Function]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_strictMono
source:

  intro a b hab
  rw [eta42_formula,eta42_formula]
  split_ifs with ha hb
  · exact hab
  · nlinarith [sq_nonneg b]
  · linarith
  · nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hab) (show 0<b+a by linarith)]

    ModAB.originalL (-3) (11/10) (-1) <

theorem eta42_orbit (n : ℕ) : leftOrbit 1 ⟨1,11/10,true⟩ (n+1)=eta42State n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact eta42_first_steps.1
  | succ n ih =>
    change leftStep 1 (leftOrbit 1 ⟨1,11/10,true⟩ (n+1)) = eta42State (n+1)
    rw [ih,eta42_step]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_shrinks
source:
theorem eta42_shrinks (n : ℕ) : eta42Error (n+1) ≤ (1/2)*eta42Error n :=
  quadraticMap_half (eta42_positive n).le

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_strict_decrease
source:
theorem eta42_strict_decrease (n : ℕ) : eta42Error (n+1)<eta42Error n := by
  linarith [eta42_shrinks n,eta42_positive n]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_antitone
source:
theorem eta42_antitone : Antitone eta42Error :=
  antitone_nat_of_succ_le (fun n=>(eta42_strict_decrease n).le)

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_bound
source:
theorem eta42_bound (n : ℕ) : eta42Error n ≤ 1/21 :=
  eta42_antitone (Nat.zero_le n)

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_next_bound
source:
theorem eta42_next_bound (n : ℕ) : eta42Error (n+1) ≤ 1/483 := by
  rw [← eta42_first_steps.2.1]
  exact eta42_antitone (by omega)

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_tendsto
source:
theorem eta42_tendsto : Tendsto eta42Error atTop (𝓝 0) :=
  geometric_tendsto (fun n=>(eta42_positive n).le) (by norm_num)
    (by norm_num) eta42_shrinks

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_reciprocal
source:
theorem eta42_reciprocal (n : ℕ) : 1+1/eta42Error n = (22:ℝ)^(2^n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num [eta42Error]
  | succ n ih =>
    have he := ne_of_gt (eta42_positive n)
    calc
      1+1/eta42Error (n+1) = (1+1/eta42Error n)^2 := by
        simp only [eta42Error,quadraticMap]
        field_simp
        <;> ring
      _ = ((22:ℝ)^(2^n))^2 := by rw [ih]
      _ = (22:ℝ)^(2^(n+1)) := by rw [← pow_mul, pow_succ]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_closed_form
source:
theorem eta42_closed_form (n : ℕ) : eta42Error n = 1/((22:ℝ)^(2^n)-1) := by
  rw [← eta42_reciprocal]
  simp

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_quadratic_order
source:
theorem eta42_quadratic_order :
    Tendsto (fun n=>eta42Error (n+1)/(eta42Error n)^2) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  have hq (n : ℕ) : eta42Error (n+1)/(eta42Error n)^2=1/(1+2*eta42Error n) := by
    have he := ne_of_gt (eta42_positive n)
    simp only [eta42Error,quadraticMap]
    field_simp
  simp_rw [hq]
  have ht := (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ=>(1:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 1)).div
    ((eta42_tendsto.const_mul 2).const_add 1) (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)+2*0≠0)
  change Tendsto (fun n=>(1:ℝ)/(1+2*eta42Error n)) atTop (𝓝 (1/(1+2*(0:ℝ)))) at ht
  simpa only [mul_zero,add_zero,div_one,one_div] using ht

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42FullError
source: def eta42FullError (j : ℕ) : ℝ := (leftOrbit 1 ⟨1,11/10,true⟩ j).e

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_full_tail
source:
theorem eta42_full_tail (n : ℕ) : eta42FullError (n+1)=eta42Error n := by
  simp only [eta42FullError,eta42_orbit,eta42State]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_full_positive
source:
theorem eta42_full_positive (j : ℕ) : 0<eta42FullError j := by
  cases j with
  | zero => norm_num [eta42FullError,leftOrbit]
  | succ n => rw [eta42_full_tail]; exact eta42_positive n

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_full_decrease
source:
theorem eta42_full_decrease (j : ℕ) : eta42FullError (j+1)<eta42FullError j := by
  cases j with
  | zero => norm_num [eta42FullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial]
  | succ n => rw [eta42_full_tail,eta42_full_tail]; exact eta42_strict_decrease n

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_full_bound
source:
theorem eta42_full_bound (j : ℕ) : eta42FullError j ≤ 1 := by
  cases j with
  | zero => norm_num [eta42FullError,leftOrbit]
  | succ n => rw [eta42_full_tail]; linarith [eta42_bound n]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_full_tendsto
source:
theorem eta42_full_tendsto : Tendsto eta42FullError atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  apply (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mp
  simpa only [eta42_full_tail] using eta42_tendsto

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_width_limit
source:
theorem eta42_width_limit : Tendsto (fun j=>1+eta42FullError j) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  simpa using eta42_full_tendsto.const_add 1

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_full_ordinate_positive
source:
theorem eta42_full_ordinate_positive (j : ℕ) :
    0 < (leftOrbit 1 ⟨1,11/10,true⟩ j).v := by
  cases j with
  | zero => norm_num [leftOrbit]
  | succ n => rw [eta42_orbit]; change 0<1+eta42Error n; linarith [eta42_positive n]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_positive_correction
source:
theorem eta42_positive_correction (j : ℕ) :
    0 < 1-eta42FullError (j+1)/eta42FullError j ∧
    ModAB.Convergence.abFactor (-eta42FullError (j+1)) (-eta42FullError j) =
      1-eta42FullError (j+1)/eta42FullError j := by
  have h := (div_lt_one (eta42_full_positive j)).mpr (eta42_full_decrease j)
  have hp : 0<1-eta42FullError (j+1)/eta42FullError j := by linarith
  exact ⟨hp,by simp [ModAB.Convergence.abFactor,hp]⟩

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_actual_update
source:
theorem eta42_actual_update (j : ℕ) :
    ModAB.Convergence.Updated eta42Function (-eta42FullError j) 1
      (-eta42FullError (j+1)) (-eta42FullError (j+1)) 1 ∧
    -eta42FullError (j+1)∈Ioo (-eta42FullError j) 1 ∧
    eta42Function (-eta42FullError (j+1))≠0 := by
  have he:=eta42_full_positive j
  have hn:=eta42_full_positive (j+1)
  have hd:=eta42_full_decrease j
  refine ⟨left_updated (p:=1) he hn (by simpa using eta42_left he.le)
    (by simpa using eta42_left hn.le),⟨by linarith,by linarith⟩,?_⟩
  rw [eta42_left hn.le]; linarith

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_residual_ratio
source:
theorem eta42_residual_ratio (n : ℕ) :
    eta42FullError (n+3)/eta42FullError (n+2) ≤ 1/485 := by
  rw [show n+3=(n+2)+1 by omega,show n+2=(n+1)+1 by omega,
    eta42_full_tail,eta42_full_tail]
  change quadraticMap (eta42Error (n+1))/eta42Error (n+1) ≤ 1/485
  have he:=eta42_positive (n+1)
  have hd : 0<1+2*eta42Error (n+1) := by positivity
  have hq : quadraticMap (eta42Error (n+1))/eta42Error (n+1) =
      eta42Error (n+1)/(1+2*eta42Error (n+1)) := by
    unfold quadraticMap; field_simp
  rw [hq]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr
  linarith [eta42_next_bound n]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_residual_exception
source:
theorem eta42_residual_exception (n : ℕ) :
    |eta42Function (-eta42FullError (n+3))| < (1/42)*
      min |eta42Function (-eta42FullError (n+2))| |eta42Function 1| := by
  have he:=eta42_full_positive (n+2)
  rw [eta42_left (eta42_full_positive (n+3)).le,eta42_left he.le,eta42_right,
    abs_neg,abs_neg,abs_of_pos (eta42_full_positive (n+3)),abs_of_pos he]
  norm_num only [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<11/10)]
  rw [min_eq_left (show eta42FullError (n+2)≤11/10 by linarith [eta42_full_bound (n+2)])]
  have h:=(div_le_iff₀ he).mp (eta42_residual_ratio n)
  nlinarith only [h,he]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_width_test_fails
source:
theorem eta42_width_test_fails (n : ℕ) :
    ModAB.Convergence.threshold 2 2 (n+3)<1+eta42FullError (n+3) := by
  have hp : (2:ℝ)^3≤2^(n+3):=pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have ht : ModAB.Convergence.threshold 2 2 (n+3)≤1:=by
    unfold ModAB.Convergence.threshold
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<(2:ℝ)^(n+3))).mpr
    norm_num at hp ⊢
    exact hp
  linarith [eta42_full_positive (n+3)]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42UncappedContinues
source:
def eta42UncappedContinues (j : ℕ) : Prop :=
  1+eta42FullError j≤ModAB.Convergence.threshold 2 2 j ∨
  |eta42Function (-eta42FullError j)| < (1/42)*
    min |eta42Function (-eta42FullError (j-1))| |eta42Function 1|

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_uncapped_continues
source:
theorem eta42_uncapped_continues (j : ℕ) (hj : 1≤j) : eta42UncappedContinues j := by
  rcases j with _|_|_|n
  · omega
  · left; norm_num [eta42FullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial,ModAB.Convergence.threshold]
  · left; norm_num [eta42FullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial,ModAB.Convergence.threshold]
  · right
    rw [show n+3-1=n+2 by omega]
    exact eta42_residual_exception n

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_no_width_termination
source:
theorem eta42_no_width_termination {τ : ℝ} (hτ : τ≤1) (j : ℕ) :
    τ<1+eta42FullError j := by linarith [eta42_full_positive j]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_mixed_tolerance_fails
source:
theorem eta42_mixed_tolerance_fails {ea er : ℝ} (ha : ea<1) :
    ∀ᶠj in atTop,ea+er*|(-eta42FullError j)|<1+eta42FullError j := by
  have ht := ((eta42_full_tendsto.neg).abs.const_mul er).const_add ea
  have ht' : Tendsto (fun j=>ea+er*|(-eta42FullError j)|) atTop (𝓝 ea):=by simpa using ht
  have hevent := (tendsto_order.mp ht').2 1 ha
  filter_upwards [hevent] with j hj
  linarith [eta42_full_positive j]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42NextMode
source:
def eta42NextMode (t c : ℕ) : ModAB.Convergence.Mode :=
  ModAB.Convergence.adaptiveMode 2 2 (1/42)
    |eta42Function (-eta42FullError (t+1))|
    (min |eta42Function (-eta42FullError t)| |eta42Function 1|)
    (1+eta42FullError (t+1)) 3 t c

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_capped_exception
source:
theorem eta42_capped_exception (n c : ℕ) (hc : c<3) :
    eta42NextMode (n+2) c = .ab 2 (n+3) (c+1) := by
  have hw := not_le.mpr (eta42_width_test_fails n)
  have hr := eta42_residual_exception n
  simp only [eta42NextMode,ModAB.Convergence.adaptiveMode]
  rw [if_neg hw,if_pos ⟨hr,hc⟩]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_cap_forces_fallback
source:
theorem eta42_cap_forces_fallback (n : ℕ) : eta42NextMode (n+2) 3 = .bisection := by
  have hw := not_le.mpr (eta42_width_test_fails n)
  simp only [eta42NextMode,ModAB.Convergence.adaptiveMode]
  rw [if_neg hw]
  norm_num

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_capped_schedule
source:
theorem eta42_capped_schedule :
    eta42NextMode 0 0 = .ab 2 1 0 ∧ eta42NextMode 1 0 = .ab 2 2 0 ∧
    eta42NextMode 2 0 = .ab 2 3 1 ∧ eta42NextMode 3 1 = .ab 2 4 2 ∧
    eta42NextMode 4 2 = .ab 2 5 3 ∧ eta42NextMode 5 3 = .bisection := by
  refine ⟨?_,?_,eta42_capped_exception 0 0 (by norm_num),
    eta42_capped_exception 1 1 (by norm_num),eta42_capped_exception 2 2 (by norm_num),
    eta42_cap_forces_fallback 3⟩
  all_goals norm_num [eta42NextMode,ModAB.Convergence.adaptiveMode,
    eta42FullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial,ModAB.Convergence.threshold]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_uncapped_counterexample
source:
theorem eta42_uncapped_counterexample :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 eta42Function ∧ StrictMono eta42Function ∧
    (∀x,eta42Function x=0↔x=0) ∧ HasDerivAt eta42Function 1 0 ∧
    (∀j,1≤j→eta42UncappedContinues j) ∧
    Tendsto eta42FullError atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
    Tendsto (fun j=>1+eta42FullError j) atTop (𝓝 1) :=
  ⟨eta42_C1,eta42_strictMono,eta42_zero_iff,eta42_simple_root,
    eta42_uncapped_continues,eta42_full_tendsto,eta42_width_limit⟩

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_top_entry
source:
theorem eta42_top_entry :
    ModAB.Convergence.Updated eta42Function (-3) 1 (-1) (-1) 1 ∧
    topLeftSeed (-3) (11/10) = ⟨1,11/10,true⟩ := by
  constructor
  · norm_num [ModAB.Convergence.Updated,eta42_formula]
  · exact topLeftSeed_eq _ _
